# Accepted (standard) MARC 21 bibliographic field tags.

# Generated by tools/build_standard_marc_fields.py from
# https://www.loc.gov/marc/bibliographic/ecbdlist.html -- but this file is
# meant to be hand-edited. One entry per line: TAG | TITLE. Blank lines and
# lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Any tag NOT listed in either section is non-standard. Tags in [obsolete]
# are non-standard and reported as obsolete. 9XX tags are never reported
# (handled by the checker, not this file).
#
# 590 and 690 are accepted local fields; other 59X/69X are non-standard.
